description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Fabulous Beach Home!* Deeded Private Beach Access Just Steps Away* Panoramic Gulf Views – Take in breathtaking coastal views from the spacious balconies* Private Pool (add'l $75/night fee)* Pet Friendly (add'l $250 fee)* 3 Complimentary Bikes* Dedicated Coffee Station and Wet Bar – Includes an ice maker* Expansive Outdoor Spaces – Multiple balconies and outdoor areas provide plenty of room to relax* Minutes to The Big Chill – Enjoy dining, live music, and family-friendly entertainment* Close to Alys Beach, Rosemary Beach & Watersound* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service*This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under the age of 25. No Exceptions. **Smart home technology is used to help ensure policy compliance and may include remotely monitored thermostats, door locks, pool/spa heater controls, a decibel meter, and video surveillance, including the front door and pool area.*Welcome to Sandy Knickers, a magnificent three-story beach home in Seacrest Beach, perfectly situated south of 30A between Alys Beach and Watersound. With panoramic Gulf views, a private pool, deeded beach access, and spacious accommodations for up to 14 guests. The beach is just steps away via the deeded beach access, making it easy to spend your days swimming in the emerald-green Gulf waters. Head home to cool off in the private pool or relax on one of the spacious balconies. The luxurious third-floor King suite is a true highlight, featuring a brand-new bathroom, incredible Gulf views, and balcony access. Two additional King suites are located on the first floor, each featuring its own private ensuite bathroom. The second-floor bunk room includes two Queen beds plus a Queen trundle, providing flexible sleeping arrangements for children or larger groups. The fully equipped kitchen makes preparing meals for your group easy. Gather around the dining table with seating for six or enjoy additional seating for six at the beautiful marble peninsula. Outside, Sandy Knickers offers plenty of space to relax and enjoy the coastal setting, book now!The Bed Setup:1st Floor:Master Bedroom: King BedGuest Bedroom: King Bed2nd Floor:Bunk Bedroom: 4 Queens 3rd Floor:Master Bedroom: King BedArea Attractions:Rosemary Beach is only minutes away, with shops and restaurants, including the Old World-style town center w/coffee shop, bike and surf rentals, and unique shops. Check out the open-air markets on the weekends. Enjoy the beautiful sugar-white sand beaches that made 30A world famous. Enjoy walking and biking everywhere around Rosemary, Seacrest, and Alys Beach. Don't miss the newly opened 30Avenue for even more dining and shopping options. 30Avenue is just north of Rosemary across Hwy 98, near both Shades Sports Bar and The Donut Hole. This laid-back, fun family atmosphere awaits you! Come stay and play and see for yourself what makes our community and the 30A area so special! The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Grouper Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 970 feet out from the Inlet Beach access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Grouper Reef is at a depth of 12-21 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
